4-vesta.x: Vesta asteroid settlement, the first human deep-space colony world targeted in the opening strike of the Chig War.

lhs-1140.x: Benchmark temperate world observed with JWST NIRISS and NIRSpec, revealing signatures consistent with a nitrogen atmosphere and secondary ocean.
Temperate habitable-zone Super-Earth 48 light-years away in Cetus, confirmed by JWST to possess a substantial atmosphere.

hr-8799-e.x: Innermost giant planet of the famed HR 8799 four-planet architecture, analyzed with JWST NIRCam and MIRI to determine atmospheric molecular chemistry.
